execute.sql: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "public"

CREATE TABLE "public"."Post" (
  "authorId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "content" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."User" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "name" text,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "username" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."avaliacoes" (
  "cliente_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "comentario" text,
  "data_avaliacao" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "nota" int4 NOT NULL,
  "pedido_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "produto_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "avaliacoes_nota_1_a_5_9e21ccee" CHECK (nota BETWEEN 1 AND 5)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."clientes" (
  "canal_aquisicao" text NOT NULL,
  "cidade" text NOT NULL,
  "data_cadastro" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "data_nascimento" date NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "estado" text NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "newsletter" bool NOT NULL,
  "nome" text NOT NULL,
  "regiao" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."itens_pedido" (
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "pedido_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "preco_unitario" numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  "produto_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "quantidade" int4 NOT NULL,
  "sabor_id" int4,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."pedidos" (
  "cliente_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "cupom" text,
  "data_pedido" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "forma_pagamento" text NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "status" text NOT NULL,
  "valor_desconto" numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  "valor_frete" numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  "valor_itens" numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  "valor_total" numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "pedidos_status_check_15f7032d" CHECK ("status" IN ('Pago', 'Enviado', 'Entregue', 'Cancelado', 'Reembolsado'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."produtos" (
  "categoria" text NOT NULL,
  "custo" numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "nome" text NOT NULL,
  "preco_atual" numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  "preco_cheio" numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  "qtd_unidades" int4 NOT NULL,
  "tem_sabor" bool NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "produtos_categoria_check_b264025d" CHECK ("categoria" IN ('Energy Drink', 'Pack', 'Combo', 'Snack'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."sabores" (
  "cor_hex" text NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "nome" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."sessoes" (
  "adicionou_carrinho" bool NOT NULL,
  "cliente_id" int4,
  "converteu" bool NOT NULL,
  "data_hora" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "dispositivo" text NOT NULL,
  "duracao_seg" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" BIGSERIAL NOT NULL,
  "origem" text NOT NULL,
  "paginas_vistas" int4 NOT NULL,
  "pedido_id" int4,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
